node.statement: Step 3: Output rho_hat = tr_2(|v><v|), the partial trace of the pure state estimate over the ancilla register C^r. By Uhlmann theorem, F(rho, rho_hat) = F(rho, tr_2(|v><v|)) >= |<v|rho_bar>|^2 >= 1-epsilon. This follows because: (i) |rho_bar> is a purification of rho, (ii) |v> is close to |rho_bar>, so (iii) tr_2(|v><v|) is close to rho in fidelity. Total sample complexity: n = O((rd + log(1/delta))/epsilon), matching the lower bound [Yue23] in all parameters.
